state.question: For Inlet Board, what do the latest records show about tariff affordability? Please resolve this specific point: The September standard household bill as a share of the median low-income household's monthly income.
state.conclusion: Inlet announced a revised household water tariff.
state.gap: The September standard household bill as a share of the median low-income household's monthly income.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Inlet Board's strategy in tariff affordability, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Nora Lim's Dispatch's dispatch on Inlet Board, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Inlet tariff and household-income workbook supports a dated assessment of the September standard household bill as a share of the median low-income household's monthly income.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Inlet Board, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the September standard household bill as a share of the median low-income household's monthly income.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: Inlet Board features in a field guide to tariff affordability. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a hotel review describes affordable bottled water at Inlet Marina.

candidates.title: Inlet Board: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Inlet Board's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.
